label: ISS metricType (diagnostic only)
economic_definition: Raw ISS metricType (diagnostic only; categories changed in 2018)

label: ISS metric label
economic_definition: ISS standardized metric label (read jointly with metricOther; 2018-taxonomy ESG labels never used as evidence)

label: ISS metricOther (raw)
economic_definition: Raw ISS metricOther text

label: text_id
economic_definition: Stable identifier of a classification unit = 'T' + first 10 hex digits of SHA-1(text_key)

label: text_key
economic_definition: Standardized classification key: metric || lower(normalized metricOther) [|| ctx=<structured context>]

label: Strict ESG 1/0/.
economic_definition: Strict ESG: the performance condition explicitly references an environmental, social or governance objective

label: Extended ESG 1/0/.
economic_definition: Extended ESG: Strict ESG or an explicit stakeholder (customer, product responsibility, community, service reliability) objective

label: esg_extended_only
economic_definition: 1 if Extended but not Strict; 0 if not Extended or Strict; . if undecidable

label: esg_e
economic_definition: Strict ESG with an explicit environmental component
missing_interpretation: Unknown: Strict unknown, or general ESG term / ambiguous E word leaves pillar unresolved

label: esg_s
economic_definition: Strict ESG with an explicit social component

label: esg_g
economic_definition: Strict ESG with an explicit, specific governance component

label: classification_status
economic_definition: confirmed = adjudicated human label; provisional = rule label not yet human-verified; unknown = unresolved

label: classification_method
economic_definition: deterministic_rule / structured_context / human_review / unresolved

label: classification_confidence
economic_definition: high / medium / low (rule confidence) or human

label: classification_reason
economic_definition: Every rule that fired with the matched text, masks applied, and label notes (full audit trail)

label: DIAGNOSTIC ISS ESG metricType/label
economic_definition: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: based on ISS metricType (Social/Environment/CSR) or 2018 ESG metric labels; never used for primary labels

label: ISS percentVest (share of award per period; -9999 codes -> .)
economic_definition: ISS percentVest (share of award per period; -9999 codes -> .)

label: vestlow
economic_definition: vestlow

label: vesthigh
economic_definition: vesthigh

label: 1 if grantId found in grants table
economic_definition: 1 if grantId found in grants table
